runtimeRendering.qualification: S5 raster shadow and filtering adaptation, visually compared with the saved Blender view; original color/alpha PNGs and source geometry are unchanged. Disk/rectangle indirect-light parity remains approximate.

floorAmbientOcclusion.qualification: Neutral static-floor AO baked in Blender on unchanged native Lightmap UV; other atlases omitted due UV overlaps. Not native S5Runtime lightmap parity.

diffuseFill.qualification: Runtime diffuse fill for toon characters indoors; toon materials cannot use the PBR environment or RectArea lights. Map-local light, no character texture/material changes.
